name: Central Carolina Comic Con
blurb: A regional comic convention at the S.C. State Fairgrounds in Columbia, part of VXV Events' touring circuit of small comic and anime shows.

editions.evidence: vxvevents.com/events '2027 Events' list: 'Central Carolina Comic Con January 16 & 17 2027 S.C. State Fairgrounds Columbia, SC' (its 2026-01-10/11 edition has already passed).

notes: VXV Events runs ~20 small regional comic/anime shows under one umbrella site with no per-show pages; vxvevents.com/events is a single combined 2026/2027 calendar (its own text, not an aggregator) used as evidence here and cross-checked by fetching it twice. The site has no Celebrities/Guests nav item; its only guest-adjacent pages (Artists, Cosplayers) are generic sign-up/apply pages listing every VXV show's logo, not an announced lineup for this show, so guests is 'none'. Cover uses the shared VXV Events logo since no Central-Carolina-specific art could be confirmed (unlike Arkansas Card Show, SpaCon and Mississippi Card Show, whose own logo files are identifiable by filename on that same page).
